A1.justification: Both PDFs describe MultihopSpatial and provide readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices. Relocated and renumbered material can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations of 37 VLMs, spatial post-training experiments, CALVIN/LIBERO results, and training ablations in Tables 1–5.

after.justification: v2 retains these empirical results and adds training-corpus, model-scale, and alternative-metric analyses in Appendix B.3–B.5.

M1.justification: The GRPO/LoRA procedure, three-component reward, normalized GIoU reward in Equations 1–2, and VLA integration remain unchanged. Applying the same procedure to larger Qwen3-VL models does not introduce a new method component.

E1.justification: Appendix B.3 adds actual training on the separate 6,885-example OmniSpatial-Train corpus; v1 used OmniSpatial only for evaluation and discussion. The MultihopSpatial data, five external evaluation benchmarks, and two embodied benchmarks remain.

E2.justification: New Table 6 evaluates OmniSpatial-trained Qwen3-VL models as alternative-corpus controls at 4B, 8B, and 32B. The corresponding v1 training-utility comparison contained only the base 4B model and MultihopSpatial-trained model. The main 37-model comparator roster is unchanged.

E3.justification: v2 extends post-training comparisons to 8B and 32B models and re-evaluates all 37 models using Acc@25IoU and Acc@CIB. These introduce additional configurations and scoring procedures; the previously documented splits, prompts, training budgets, and primary metrics remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Appendix B.3–B.5 substantially expands diagnostic evidence through training-corpus controls, model-scale generalization tests, and sensitivity of rankings to grounding criteria. The original RL-versus-SFT and reward-weight ablations remain unchanged. Table 8 additionally supplies fuller traces for the existing Figure 15 failure case.

E5.justification: Appendix B.5 introduces Spearman rank-correlation analysis across 37 models to compare grounding metrics, a statistical procedure absent from v1. Seed, repeated-run, and uncertainty-reporting practices otherwise remain unchanged.

E6.justification: Table 1 revises overall Acc@50IoU from 0.0 to 16.2 for VST-7B-RL, 0.3 to 22.7 for SpaceOm, and 4.0 to 14.4 for SpaceThinker-3B, while their MCQ accuracies remain unchanged. Updated Figure 9 reverses the specialist-versus-instant-generalist grounding ranking. Table 6 and Appendix B.5 add corpus/scale results and alternative-metric findings. The PDFs do not explain the cause of the specialist-score revisions.

T1.justification: Appendix B.5 adds the Acc@CIB definition: a correct MCQ answer together with the predicted box center lying inside the ground-truth box. This extends the mathematical scoring criteria. Existing reward equations remain unchanged, and no proofs or theorems are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same central contributions: the compositional benchmark, grounded Acc@50IoU evaluation, and a training corpus that improves VLM reasoning and downstream VLA performance.

C2.justification: Analysis A5 replaces the claim that specialists underperform across all metrics with complementary strengths: weaker answer selection but better grounding than instant generalists. A3 qualifies diminishing reasoning benefits by perspective. Appendix B.5 recognizes coarse localization missed by strict IoU, and the relocated limitations section adds the absence of industrial and warehouse visual domains.

D1.justification: The first page adds direct dataset, trained-model, and code links alongside the existing project website, improving documented access information. Appendix A's implementation, hardware, and training details are unchanged; the linked resources themselves were not accessed.

R1.justification: Section 4 newly positions the RL procedure as a deliberately minimal, data-focused baseline relative to specialized spatial-reasoning techniques. Appendix B.3 directly positions the corpus against OmniSpatial-Train. The cited-work set remains unchanged after matching corrected bibliographic records.

P1.justification: Localized rewrites clarify compositional reasoning and revise several analysis paragraphs. New appendix subsections are inserted, and limitations move from Appendix F to C, with subsequent sections renumbered. The overall narrative, abstract, and conclusion remain substantially intact.

P2.justification: v2 adds the corpus-comparison table, rank-correlation figure, and full-trace table (Table 6, Figure 16, Table 8). Existing plots receive revised annotations and placement, while annotation screenshots and qualitative figures are reordered. All ten earlier qualitative examples are retained.

improvement.justification: The corpus controls, larger-model experiments, and alternative-metric checks in Appendix B.3–B.5 strengthen validation, while direct resource links improve reproducibility information. The gains are limited by unexplained specialist-score revisions and incomplete reconciliation of interpretations: A6 still characterizes Molmo2 as lacking spatial understanding, whereas B.5 demonstrates substantial coarse localization.
